verdict.label: accept

No obvious joint, part-count, or constraint violation is visible. Runtime stats and joint_state could not be confirmed because the observation budget is exhausted.

offline_budget_one_comparison.source: scripts/compare_teacher_acquisition.py with candidate auto-framing matching the teacher runner
offline_budget_one_comparison.result: Kimi is worse than random on clean observation novelty and exactly matches random on the controlled-defect action and pixels; no acquisition advantage was observed.
offline_budget_one_comparison.diagnosis_comparison: Not available: the offline controls execute acquisition only and make no model verdict call.
offline_budget_one_comparison.oracle_caveat: The existing privileged Oracle export uses sample framing while the teacher runner uses candidate auto-framing; its exposure lookup is not treated as a strict pixel-matched comparison.

summary.student_learnable_new_supervision: One visible-only defect-view action is a candidate action label, but it exactly duplicates the random seed-0 action and pixels; both terminal outputs are unusable.
summary.recommendation: Do not expand paid collection until the full verdict JSON schema is explicit in the prompt and passes an offline structured-output contract test.
